title: Only The Fastest
description: Faster Minecraft at the tips of your fingers.
body:
Only The Fastest (OTF) is a performance focused modpack built to make Minecraft run as smooth as possible. It boosts FPS, lowers lag, and speeds up loading without changing how the game plays. Everything stays vanilla, just faster and cleaner.

OTF includes smart optimizations, visual fixes, and small quality of life tweaks that make the game feel better to play. Menus are snappier, chunks load quicker, and the game is more stable overall. It is great for low end PCs, laptops, or anyone who wants the best performance possible while keeping Minecraft feeling normal.

There are some server side mods (not many) that only work on singleplayer. 90+% of the mods are CLIENT SIDE ONLY so you can use them whereever.
